live_claims.text: The paper casts dataset pruning as a graph problem with node weights for intrinsic importance and edge weights for extrinsic diversity/interaction, yielding a Maximum Weight Clique formulation (Section 3.3).
Under mild conditions, the unified objective becomes submodular and admits a greedy approximation guarantee (Section 3.6; Appendix F).
UGIES outperforms state-of-the-art dataset pruning methods on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-18 (Table 1).
On ImageNet-1K, UGIES achieves lossless or better-than-lossless pruning with ResNet-50 and Swin-T at moderate pruning ratios (Table 2).
With ResNet-50 on ImageNet-1K at a 50% pruning ratio, UGIES reaches the same accuracy while saving 43.2% total training cost (Table 3).
Ablations show combining intrinsic and extrinsic importance terms outperforms using either component alone across pruning ratios (Table 4).

claims.claim: The paper casts dataset pruning as a graph problem with node weights for intrinsic importance and edge weights for extrinsic diversity/interaction, yielding a Maximum Weight Clique formulation (Section 3.3).
claims.evidence: The logbook's exact rational audit found the literal samplewise formulation double-counts symmetric pair interactions: the MWCP value is 1/1 while the literal samplewise value is 2/1, and the objective-equivalence check is classified as contradicted, indicating the formulation as stated does not correctly reduce to MWCP.
claims.target_claim: The paper casts dataset pruning as a graph problem with node weights for intrinsic importance and edge weights for extrinsic diversity/interaction, yielding a Maximum Weight Clique formulation (Section 3.3).

claims.claim: Under mild conditions, the unified objective becomes submodular and admits a greedy approximation guarantee (Section 3.6; Appendix F).
claims.evidence: The logbook provides a concrete witness where the marginal sequence is 1/1 then 3/1, directly violating the diminishing-returns property required for submodularity; the diminishing-returns and greedy-premise checks are both classified as contradicted under exact rational arithmetic.
